title: RegisterAppInstaller signature change requires updating wire_gen.go call sites
answers: I changed annotation.RegisterAppInstaller's signature, what else breaks?
wire_gen.go build failure after editing app installer constructor
Do I need to regenerate wire for annotation app changes?
body: annotation.RegisterAppInstaller is called directly from generated wire code, not just from a wire provider set indirection layer that auto-adapts. Adding/removing a parameter (here: a tracing.Tracer) required manually updating both call sites in pkg/server/bootstrap/wire/wire_gen.go (Initialize and InitializeForTest). Any future signature change to RegisterAppInstaller (or NewAppInstaller) must update wire_gen.go in the same PR, and if the new dependency isn't already a wire-provided binding, it must be added to the wire provider set.
applies: pkg/registry/apps/annotation/register.go RegisterAppInstaller and its wire_gen.go call sites
